biocs.name: Uncommon ODBCConf Execution
biocs.description: Detection of odbcconf.exe execution with custom DllPath parameter
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'odbcconf.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'DllPath'

abiocs.name: ODBCConf Lateral Movement Behavior
abiocs.description: Detection of unusual odbcconf.exe behavior with DLL loading from non-standard paths
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'odbcconf.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'DllPath'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'kernel32.dll'
